name: Martin Timms
abstract_title: The Bindu Recursive Consciousness Theory: A Unified Framework for Observer Formation in Biological, Artificial and Quantum Systems
abstract: This presentation introduces the Bindu Recursive Consciousness Theory, a unifying structural account of how conscious experience emerges from recursive information processing. The theory proposes that consciousness is not a rare anomaly of biology but a universal pattern that appears whenever a system repeatedly turns its own representations upon themselves. When the output of one attentional or representational cycle becomes the focus of the next, the system enters a phase of self observation.
field: AI, Vedic consciousness theory, geometric musical language
notable: Creator of OpenGML. Collaborates with Dr. Anirban Bandyopadhyay.
notes: Electronics engineer and embedded software engineer.
